os.headline: Respected locally, *nearly invisible online.*
os.lede: AI answers lean on what other sites say. Few say anything about this firm yet.
os.callout: **Why this pillar carries the most weight.** Two Ahrefs studies (vendor, correlational) found brand mentions tracked AI visibility far more than backlinks or page count; a separate study (Moore and Dunne, vendor authors, B2B SaaS) found domain-level factors explained far more than page features.
